@@U00158@@
I have no friend of my youth to pass it on to, nor any reason now for rhyming. This is a drink that soon intoxicates, a drink I prepared myself and now pour its dark liquid into your brimming cup. I pledge it now, with all my heart, to the new day.

@@U00159@@
(As he puts the goblet to his lips, church bells and a choir are heard.)

@@U00161@@
Christ is ascended! Hail the glad token, True was it spoken, Sin’s fetters are broken, Man's bondage is ended!

@@U00163@@
What deep resonance, what clear, shining note has such power to drag this chalice from my lips? Muted bells announce the Easter festival, and choirs sing their song of consolation first sung by angels at that darkened tomb— proclamation of a new faith, a new covenant.

@@U00165@@
With myrrh and with aloes We balmed and we bathed Him, Loyally, lovingly, Tenderly swathed Him; With cerecloth and band For the grave we arrayed Him; But, oh, He is gone From the place where we laid Him!

@@U00167@@
Christ is ascended! The love that possessed Him, The pangs that oppressed Him,
translation:
@@U00158@@
我没有年轻时的朋友可以将它传递给我，现在也没有任何理由押韵。这是一种很快就会让人陶醉的饮料，是我自己准备的饮料，现在将其黑色液体倒入你满溢的杯子中。我现在全心全意地向新的一天保证。

@@U00159@@
（当他把高脚杯放到唇边时，教堂的钟声和唱诗班的声音响起。）

@@U00161@@
基督升天了！向这令人高兴的象征致敬，这句话是真的，罪恶的枷锁被打破，人类的束缚结束了！

@@U00163@@
是什么深刻的共鸣，什么清晰、闪亮的音符有如此力量将这个圣杯从我的嘴唇上拖走？柔和的钟声宣告了复活节的到来，唱诗班唱起了天使在黑暗的坟墓中首先唱出的安慰之歌——宣告了新的信仰、新的圣约。

@@U00165@@
我们用没药和芦荟给他涂香膏，给他沐浴，忠诚、慈爱、温柔地包裹着他；我们用花布和带子为他披上坟墓；但是，哦，他已经从我们安放他的地方走了！

@@U00167@@
基督升天了！占有他的爱，压迫他的痛苦，
